10:1: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the wise Book.
10:2: Was it a wonder for the people that We revealed to a man from among them: 'Warn the people and give glad tidings to those who believe that they have a station of truthfulness with their Rabb'? The disbelievers said: 'Indeed, this is an obvious magician.'
10:3: Indeed, your Rabb is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then established Himself upon the Arsh (Throne), disposing the affair. There is no intercessor except after His permission. That is Allah, your Rabb, so worship Him. Will you still not reflect?
10:4: To Him is the return of you all. The promise of Allah is true. Indeed, He originates creation, then repeats it so that He may recompense those who believe and do good deeds with justice. As for those who disbelieve, for them is a drink of boiling water and a painful punishment because they used to disbelieve.
10:5: It is He who made the sun a radiance and the moon a light and determined for it phases that you might know the number of years and the reckoning. Allah did not create this except in truth. He details the verses for a people who know.
10:6: Indeed, in the succession of night and day and in what Allah has created in the heavens and the earth, there are signs for a people who guard against evil.
10:7: Indeed, those who do not expect to meet Us, and are pleased with the life of the world and satisfied with it, and those who are heedless of Our signs,
10:8: Those—their abode is the Fire because of what they used to earn.
10:9: Indeed, those who believe and do good deeds, their Rabb guides them by means of their faith. Rivers flow beneath them in Gardens of Delight.
10:10: Their supplication therein is: "Subhan are You, O Allah!" Their greeting therein is: "Salam!" And the end of their supplication is: "Praise be to Allah, Rabb of the worlds!"
10:11: And if Allah were to hasten the evil for people as they hasten the good, their term would surely have been decreed for them. But We leave those who do not expect to meet Us wandering blindly in their transgression.
10:12: And when harm touches man, he prays to Us lying on his side, or sitting, or standing. Then when We remove his harm from him, he walks away as if he had never prayed to Us for a harm that touched him. Thus has what they used to do been made fair-seeming to the extravagant.
10:13: And certainly We destroyed the generations before you when they committed injustice and their messengers had come to them with clear proofs and they were not going to believe. Thus do We punish the guilty people.
10:14: Then We made you successors (khalifas) in the earth after them, so that We might see how you would act.
10:15: When Our verses are recited to them clearly, those who do not expect to meet Us say: 'Bring a Qur'an other than this, or change it.' Say: 'It is not for me to change it of my own accord; I only follow what is revealed to me. Indeed, I fear, if I disobey my Rabb, the punishment of a tremendous Day.'
10:16: Say: "If Allah had willed, I would not have recited it to you, nor would He have made it known to you. Certainly, I stayed among you for a lifetime before it."
10:17: Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah or denies His verses? Indeed, the guilty will not attain salvation.
10:18: And they worship besides Allah what neither harms them nor benefits them, and they say: 'These are our intercessors with Allah.' Say: 'Do you inform Allah of something He does not know in the heavens and in the earth? Subhan is He and exalted above what they associate as partners.'
10:19: And mankind was nothing but a single community, then they differed. And had not a word preceded from your Rabb, judgment would surely have been passed between them concerning that in which they differed.
10:20: And they say: 'If only a sign were sent down to him from his Rabb!' Say: 'The unseen (ghayb) belongs only to Allah, so wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait.'
10:21: And when We cause people to taste mercy after a harm that touched them, immediately they devise a plot against Our verses. Say: 'Allah is swifter in plotting.' Indeed, Our messengers write down the plots you devise.
10:22: It is He who makes you travel on land and sea. Until, when you are in the ships, and they sail with them with a good wind and they rejoice in it, a violent wind comes upon it and waves come from every place and they think that they are surrounded; they pray to Allah, making religion pure for Him: 'By Allah, if You save us from this, we will surely be of the grateful.'
10:23: When He saves them, behold, they transgress upon the earth without right. O people, your transgression is only against yourselves. A fleeting enjoyment of the life of the world. Then to Us is your return, and We will inform you of what you used to do.
10:24: The likeness of the life of the world is like water that We send down from the sky, with which the vegetation of the earth mingles from what people and animals eat. Until, when the earth takes on its ornament and is beautified, and its people think that they have power over it, Our command comes upon it by night or by day, and We make it as a harvested field, as if it had not existed yesterday. Thus do We explain the verses in detail for a people who reflect.
10:25: Allah calls to the Home of Peace and guides whom He wills to a straight path.
10:26: For those who do good is the best reward and more. Neither darkness nor humiliation shall cover their faces. Those are the people of Paradise.
10:27: As for those who earn evil deeds, the recompense of an evil deed is the like thereof, and humiliation covers them; there is no protector for them against Allah; a piece of darkness covers their faces, as if their faces were covered with dark pieces of the night; those are the companions of the Fire, they will abide therein eternally.
10:28: And on that Day We will gather them all, then We will say to those who associated partners: 'Stay in your place, you and your partners.' Then We separate between them. Their partners say: 'You did not use to worship us.'
10:29: Allah is sufficient as a witness between us and you. Indeed, we were heedless of your worship, they say.
10:30: There every soul will experience what it had put forward, and they are returned to Allah, their true Mawla, and what they used to invent is lost from them.
10:31: Say: Who provides for you from the sky and the earth? Or who has control over hearing and sight? Who brings forth the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living? Who arranges the affairs? They will say: Allah. Say: Will you not then guard against evil?
10:32: That then is Allah, your true Rabb; what is there after truth except error, so how are you turned away?
10:33: Thus has the word of your Rabb proved true against those who acted defiantly (fasik); because they do not believe.
10:34: Say: 'Who is it from among your partners that originates creation, then repeats it?' Say: 'Allah originates creation, then repeats it.' How then are you turned away?
10:35: Say: 'Is there any of your partners who guides to the truth?' Say: 'Allah guides to the truth. Is He who guides to the truth more worthy to be followed, or he who cannot find guidance unless he is guided? What is the matter with you, how do you judge?'
10:36: Most of them follow nothing but conjecture. Indeed, conjecture avails nothing against the truth. Indeed, Allah is Knower of what they do.
10:37: This Quran is not fabricated by other than Allah; on the contrary, it is a confirmation of the books before it and a detailed explanation of the Book from the Rabb of the worlds.
10:38: Or do they say, 'He fabricated it'? Say: 'If you are truthful, bring a surah like it and call upon whomever you can besides Allah.'
10:39: Rather, they denied that whose knowledge they could not encompass and whose interpretation has not yet come to them. Thus did those before them deny. Look, then, how was the end of the wrongdoers.
10:40: And of them are those who believe in it, and of them are those who do not believe in it. And your Rabb knows best the corrupters.
10:41: If they deny you, say: 'My deed is for me, and your deed is for you. You are free of what I do, and I am free of what you do.'
10:42: And of them are those who listen to you; will you then make the deaf hear, even if they do not reason?
10:43: And of them are those who look at you; and will you guide the blind, even if they do not see?
10:44: Indeed, Allah does not wrong people in anything, but people wrong themselves.
10:45: The day He gathers them, as if they had not remained except for an hour of the day, they will recognize one another; those who denied the meeting with Allah and did not enter the right path have suffered loss.
10:46: Whether We show you a part of what We have promised them or cause you to die, their return is only to Us; then Allah is witness over what they do.
10:47: And for every nation there is a messenger. When their messenger comes, it is judged between them with justice and they are not wronged.
10:48: And they say: 'When is this promise, if you are truthful?'
10:49: Say: 'I possess for myself neither harm nor benefit, except what Allah wills. For every nation there is an appointed term.'
10:50: Say: 'Have you seen, if His punishment comes upon you by night or by day, what of it do the criminals hasten?'
10:51: Then, is it when it has fallen that you will believe in it? Now, while you were seeking to hasten it?
10:52: Then it is said to those who wronged, 'Taste the eternal punishment; you are only receiving the recompense of what you used to earn, are you not?'
10:53: They ask you for information, 'Is it true?' Say: 'Yes, by my Rabb, it is true, and you cannot escape.'
10:54: If every soul that wronged had all that is on earth, it would give it as ransom. And they concealed regret when they saw the punishment. And it was judged between them with justice. And they are not wronged.
10:55: Beware, indeed, whatever is in the heavens and on the earth belongs to Allah. Beware, indeed, the promise of Allah is true, but most of them do not know.
10:56: He gives life and causes death, and to Him you will be returned.
10:57: O people! There has come to you an admonition from your Rabb, a cure for what is in the breasts, and a guidance and mercy for the believers.
10:58: Say: 'With the bounty of Allah and His mercy, with this let them rejoice. It is better than what they accumulate.'
10:59: Say: 'Have you seen that which Allah has sent down to you of provision, of which you made some unlawful and some lawful?' Say: 'Has Allah permitted you, or are you inventing a lie against Allah?'
10:60: What is the supposition of those who invent lies against Allah on the Day of Resurrection? Indeed, Allah is possessor of bounty toward people, but most of them do not give thanks.
10:61: You are not in any affair, you do not recite anything from it of the Quran, and you do not do any work, but We are witnesses over you when you are engaged in it. And not the weight of an atom in the earth or in the heaven, nor anything smaller than that or larger, is hidden from your Rabb, but that it is in a clear book.
10:62: Know well that indeed, there is no fear for the friends of Allah, nor will they grieve.
10:63: Those who have believed and who constantly maintain takva (God-consciousness).
10:64: For them is good tidings in the life of this world and in the Hereafter. There is no change in the words of Allah. That is the great salvation.
10:65: Let not their words grieve you. Indeed, honor belongs entirely to Allah. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
10:66: Know well that indeed, whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth belongs to Allah. Those who pray leaving Allah aside do not follow the partners. They follow nothing but conjecture, and they only guess.
10:67: He is the One Who made for you the night so that you may rest in it, and the day as illuminating. Indeed, in that are surely signs for a people who hear.
10:68: They said: 'Allah has taken a child.' He is transcendent (free from imperfection). He is self-sufficient. Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth belongs to Him. You have no proof concerning this with you. Do you say about Allah that which you do not know?
10:69: Say: 'Indeed, those who invent lies against Allah will not attain salvation.'
10:70: There is an enjoyment for them in the world, then their return is to Us, then We will make them taste the severe punishment because they used to disbelieve.
10:71: Recite to them the news of Noah. When he said to his people: 'O my people! If my standing and my reminding with the signs of Allah has become heavy upon you, I have put my trust in Allah. So gather your affair and your partners, then let not your affair be a distress to you. Then carry out your decree against me and do not delay me.'
10:72: If you turn away, I did not ask you for a reward. My reward belongs only to Allah. And I was commanded to be of the Muslims.
10:73: They denied him. So We saved him and those with him in the ship, and We made them successors. And We drowned those who denied Our signs. Look, then, how was the outcome of those who were warned.
10:74: Then after him We sent messengers to their peoples. They came to them with clear proofs, but they were not going to believe in that which they had denied before. Thus do We seal the hearts of the transgressors.
10:75: Then after them We sent Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his chiefs with Our signs, but they grew arrogant and became a criminal people.
10:76: When the truth came to them from Our presence, they said: 'Indeed, this is an evident magic.'
10:77: Moses said: 'Do you say against the truth whereas it has come to you? Is this magic? And magicians do not achieve success.'
10:78: They said: Have you come to us to turn us away from what we found our fathers upon and so that greatness on the earth may belong to the two of you? And we are not believers in you.
10:79: Pharaoh said: "Bring me every knowledgeable sorcerer."
10:80: When the sorcerers came, Moses said to them: Throw what you are going to throw.
10:81: When they threw, Moses said: "What you have brought is sorcery. Surely Allah will make it void. Surely Allah does not rectify the work of the corrupters."
10:82: Allah establishes the truth with His words, and even if the criminals dislike it.
10:83: In fear of Pharaoh and his notables, only an offspring from his people believed in Moses. Because Pharaoh was truly exalted on the earth, and he was of those who exceed the limits.
10:84: Moses said: O my people, if you have believed in Allah, rely upon Him, if you are Muslims.
10:85: They said: "Upon Allah we have relied. Our Rabb, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people.
10:86: And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
10:87: We revealed to Moses and his brother: "Take houses for your people in Egypt and make your houses places of prayer and establish the salah and give good tidings to the believers," We said.
10:88: Moses said: "Our Rabb! Surely You have given Pharaoh and his notables adornment and wealth in the worldly life. Our Rabb, so that they lead astray from Your way? Our Rabb, wipe out their wealth and tighten their hearts severely so that they do not believe until they see the painful punishment."
10:89: He said: "The prayer of the two of you has been accepted. So be upright and do not follow the way of those who do not know."
10:90: We took the Children of Israel across the sea. Pharaoh and his armies pursued them in rebellion and hostility. Until when drowning reached him, he said: "I have believed that there is no deity except the one in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims."
10:91: Is it now, whereas before you had rebelled and were of the corrupters, it was said.
10:92: Today We will save you with your body so that you may be a sign for those after you. Surely most of the people are truly heedless of Our signs.
10:93: And surely We settled the Children of Israel in a rightful place and provided them with good things. They did not fall into disagreement until after knowledge had come to them. Surely your Rabb will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they differed.
10:94: If you are in doubt about what We have sent down to you, ask those who read the scripture before you. Surely the truth has come to you from your Rabb, so never be of the doubters.
10:95: Do not be of those who deny the signs of Allah, otherwise you will be of the losers.
10:96: Surely those upon whom the word of your Rabb has been fulfilled do not believe.
10:97: Even if every sign comes to them, until they see the painful punishment.
10:98: Then, why was there not a city that believed and its faith benefited it! Except the people of Jonah: when they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life and We let them enjoy for a while.
10:99: If your Rabb had willed, all those on the earth would have believed together. Will you then compel the people until they become believers?
10:100: No soul can believe except by Allah's permission, and He places defilement upon those who do not use their intellect.
10:101: Say: Look at what is in the heavens and the earth. Signs and warners do not benefit a people who do not believe.
10:102: Do they await except the likeness of the days of those who passed before them? Say: Wait, surely I too am with you among those who wait.
10:103: Then We save Our messengers and those who believe. Thus it is a right upon Us to save the believers.
10:104: Say: O people, if you are in doubt about my religion, I do not worship those you worship besides Allah, but I worship Allah who causes you to die, and I was commanded to be of the believers.
10:105: And turn your face toward the religion as a hanif, and never be of the polytheists.
10:106: Do not pray besides Allah to what does not benefit you and does not harm you; if you do, then you will be of the wrongdoers.
10:107: If Allah touches you with harm, there is none to remove it other than Him, and if He intends good for you, there is none to turn back His grace.
10:108: Say: O people, the truth has come to you from your Rabb. Whoever is guided, is only guided for his own soul. And whoever strays, only strays against it. I am not a trustee over you.
10:109: Follow what is revealed to you and be patient until Allah judges. He is the best of judges.
